name: io.github.nh4ttruong/secobserve-mcp
description: MCP server for SecObserve: triage findings, manage products, import scan reports and SBOMs.

environmentVariables.name: SECOBSERVE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: SecObserve base URL without /api, e.g. https://secobserve.example.com

environmentVariables.name: SECOBSERVE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SecObserve user or product API token

environmentVariables.name: SECOBSERVE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to refuse every write operation

environmentVariables.name: SECOBSERVE_ALLOW_DELETE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable the delete tool; deletion cascades and is irreversible
